comments.value: @{5d100f3eb716313272a55e89|full_name}: Since when am I a background?? haha jk. Anyway, I do also agree on the cyan blue color.

details: Some backgrounds (most notably, cheese) look jarring when contrasted with the blue/grey hue of the rest of the UI. These backgrounds should change the UI color as well for consistency. (Low effort mockup for reference)
title: Some VRC+ backgrounds should also change the color of the UI
